# Brief template

Write the brief in the user's language. Translate the headings too (Bulgarian headings in brackets). Drop a section
only if it is genuinely not applicable.

```markdown
# <Task title> [Бриф: <заглавие>]

> Date: YYYY-MM-DD · Domain: <marketing | content | product | general> · Complexity: <simple | medium | complex>
> Questions asked: N · Owner/approver: <who>

## Goal [Цел]
One sentence: the primary outcome and why now.

## Audience [Аудитория]
Who, market, language, funnel stage.

## Deliverables & scope [Резултат и обхват]
- What exactly is produced (count, format, channel)
- **Out of scope:** …

## Channels / format [Канали и формат]
(marketing/content) channels, formats, variants, landing.

## Constraints [Ограничения]
- Budget: …
- Deadline / dates: …
- Brand & tone: …
- Legal / approvals: …
- Resources & tools: …

## Success metrics [Критерии за успех]
- Primary KPI: … → target …
- Measured in: …
- Reporting: cadence + format

## Context [Контекст]
Offer/product, what was tried before, assets available, competitors/references.

## Key decisions [Решения]
- Decision — short reason (from the interview)

## Assumptions [Допускания]
- Things inferred without asking — challenge if wrong

## Risks & edge cases [Рискове]
- …

## Open questions [Отворени въпроси]
- Question — who should answer

## Acceptance criteria [Готово е, когато]
- [ ] Checkable criterion
- [ ] …

## Suggested next steps [Следващи стъпки]
1. …
```
